name: NGOGI: No God of Good Intentions
source:
This is a love story.

In this short visual novel, you follow the young Antichrist, Damian, and his best friend Peter, from their first day together in kindergarten. Only the Antichrist is not the murderous, evil, death worshiping monster you’ve been led to believe- he’s anxious, he’s depressed, he’s socially awkward and codependent and desperate in all the ways he’s afraid to admit, and Peter is social, casual, well rounded, well liked.

Stress will kill you.

This is a story about friendship, it’s a story about anxiety, it’s a story about stress, and grief, and fiery world ending explosions, but at the end of the day, this is a story about love.

[From [url=http://ngogi.tumblr.com/post/115916525218/this-is-a-love-story-in-this-short-visual-novel]official site[/url]]
translation:
这是一个爱情故事。

在这部短篇视觉小说中，你将跟随年轻的反基督者达米安和他最好的朋友彼得，从他们在幼儿园的第一天开始。只有反基督者并不是你所相信的那个凶残、邪恶、崇拜死亡的怪物——他焦虑、抑郁、社交尴尬、相互依赖和绝望，而彼得却善于交际、随意、全面、讨人喜欢。

压力会杀死你。

这是一个关于友谊的故事，这是一个关于焦虑的故事，这是一个关于压力、悲伤和火热世界结束爆炸的故事，但归根结底，这是一个关于爱的故事。

[来自[url=http://ngogi.tumblr.com/post/115916525218/this-is-a-love-story-in-this-short-visual-novel]官方网站[/url]]
